# What this library can already do

**Generated by `npm run catalog`. Do not edit by hand.**

Search this before building anything. It exists because the same mistake
kept being made: a pager was hand-rolled while `Pagination` sat in the
library, and a `DataTable` shipped without the column controls that had
been built for it weeks earlier.

`component-catalog.json` answers _what does this look like_ - every CVA
variant and its allowed values. This file answers _what can this already
do_, which is the question that keeps getting skipped.

Nothing here is enforced by CI. It reports, like `check:tokens` does.

**Stories are not listed below** - there are hundreds of them, and they would
bury the handful of hooks that are the whole point of this file. They are still
searchable, which is what matters: `npm run find -- selectable rows` finds the
story that already exists. They are in `capability-catalog.json` in full.

786 capabilities: 186 components, 17 hooks, 12 utilities, 571 stories

| `TagPill`                  | TagPill      | TagPill - a label a person put there and can take away.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `Textarea`                 | Textarea     | Textarea component with support for labels, error states, and character counting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `Toast`                    | Toast        | Toast - notifications, wearing Org Mgmt's banner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `ToastBody`                | Toast        | ToastBody - one toast, rendered as Om's banner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `ToastPromo`               | Toast        | The promotional toast - an announcement rather than a report.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `Toggle`                   | Toggle       | Toggle component built on Radix UI Toggle primitive.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `ToggleGroup`              | ToggleGroup  | ToggleGroup component built on Radix UI ToggleGroup primitive.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `ToggleGroupItem`          | ToggleGroup  | ToggleGroupItem - individual toggle button within a ToggleGroup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `Toolbar`                  | Toolbar      | Toolbar component for displaying search, filters, and action buttons.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `ToolbarSection`           | Toolbar      | ToolbarSection component for grouping toolbar items.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `ToolbarSpacer`            | Toolbar      | ToolbarSpacer component for adding flexible space between toolbar sections.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `Tooltip`                  | Tooltip      | Tooltip root component - controls the open state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `TooltipContent`           | Tooltip      | TooltipContent - the content container for the tooltip with arrow support.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `TooltipProvider`          | Tooltip      | TooltipProvider - wraps your app or component tree to provide tooltip functionality.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `TooltipTrigger`           | Tooltip      | TooltipTrigger - the element that triggers the tooltip on hover.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

## Hooks - the behaviour

| Name                 | Where   | What it does                                                           |
| -------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `useColumnReorder`   | Table   | Drag a column sideways to move it.                                     |
| `useColumnWidths`    | Table   | Holds column widths for a resizable table.                             |
| `useDialogFooterTop` | Dialog  | The room between the footer's rule and its buttons.                    |
| `useDialogGutter`    | Dialog  | The left and right padding every region in this dialog shares.         |
| `useDialogTop`       | Dialog  | The padding above the first region.                                    |
| `useEditableTabs`    | Tabs    | The rules for a tab bar the person builds themselves.                  |
| `useInfiniteScroll`  | Table   | Asks for more rows when the end of the list comes into view.           |
| `useLeftNavLevels`   | LeftNav | Which level of a settings navigation is showing.                       |
| `usePlatform`        | Kbd     | Which machine this is, for resolving `mod` and `alt`.                  |
| `usePromotionalOpen` | Toast   | Whether a promotional toast is on screen.                              |
| `useSavedViews`      | Table   | Holds a table's saved views.                                           |
| `useSubmitShortcut`  | Dialog  | ⌘↵ on a Mac, Ctrl↵ elsewhere, for the dialog's primary action.         |
| `useTableColumns`    | Table   | Holds which columns are shown, in what order, and how many are pinned. |
| `useTableFilters`    | Table   | Holds which filters are applied.                                       |
| `useTablePagination` | Table   | Which page of a table is showing.                                      |
| `useTableSelection`  | Table   | Holds which rows are selected.                                         |
| `useTableSort`       | Table   | Holds which columns sort the table, and in what order.                 |

## Utilities

| Name                       | Where  | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cn`                       | ..     | Utility function for merging Tailwind CSS classes with proper conflict resolution.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `deprecated`               | ..     | Show a deprecation warning for a component `tsx export const OldButton = (props) => { deprecated('OldButton', { deprecatedSince: '2.0.0', removalIn: '3.0.0', replacement: 'MotadataButton', migrationGuide: 'https://docs.example.com/migration/button' }); return <button {...props} />; } ` |
| `describeKeys`             | Kbd    | What the whole combination is called - "Command + Shift + E".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `initialsForName`          | Avatar | "Sarah Johnson" -> "SJ", "monitoring" -> "mo".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `isModifier`               | Kbd    | Whether a key is a modifier rather than the key being modified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `pageList`                 | Table  | Which page numbers to show, and where the gaps go.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `promoStore`               | Toast  | _undocumented_                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `resetDeprecationWarnings` | ..     | Reset the warned components set (useful for testing)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `resolveKey`               | Kbd    | One key, as a glyph to draw and a name to announce.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `toast`                    | Toast  | Toast trigger function.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `toCsv`                    | Table  | Turns rows into CSV text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `toneForName`              | Avatar | Picks a tone from a name, so one person is always one colour.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
